contract: libvgraph borrowed raw-u32 forward CSR refinement

invariants.statement: A borrowed observation preserves the caller's offset and target buffer identities and allocates zero input-clone slots.
invariants.exhaustive: pointer identity and input_clone_slots assertions in verify_graph

invariants.statement: Admission checks offset length, origin, and terminal equality before any row observation.
Each row's adjacent offsets are ordered and bounded by the target length before slicing.
Every raw target is range-checked before it indexes dense Tarjan state.
Targets are strictly increasing inside each admitted row; decreasing and duplicate adjacent targets are rejected.
Every admitted borrowed CSR and its owned materialization denote exactly the same directed edge relation.
invariants.exhaustive: borrowed partition equals owned partition for every graph through four vertices

invariants.statement: Malformed, rejected, or cancelled computations publish no partial decomposition.
SCC quotient fibers are total, disjoint, nonempty, and exact for mutual reachability.
invariants.exhaustive: borrowed Tarjan equals independent transitive-closure oracle

invariants.statement: Canonical component identifiers are ordered by each fiber's least dense member and members are sorted.
invariants.exhaustive: ascending dense assignment and permutation assertions

invariants.statement: Condensation contains exactly the distinct cross-fiber source edges and no self-edge.
invariants.exhaustive: borrowed and owned condensation edge-set equality

invariants.statement: A singleton SCC has a nonempty directed cycle exactly when its sole vertex has a self-loop.
Fused validation performs exactly one header check, one row check per vertex, and one target check per edge, so work is linear.
Tarjan uses O(V) auxiliary heap; the complete exact pipeline retains the existing O(V+E) workspace and adds no input clone.
invariants.exhaustive: bounded active/frame metrics and zero clone slots

invariants.statement: Graph depth is represented by explicit heap frames, so native call-stack depth is independent of input depth.
invariants.exhaustive: 20,000-vertex chain on a 256 KiB native stack

invariants.statement: Permutation and duplicate invariance belong to canonical owned construction; borrowed canonical CSR rejects those noncanonical row representations.
invariants.exhaustive: adversarial reversed duplicate owned construction plus raw rejection space
